title: deck_plan
description: Presentation projection. Content-complete: the renderer is pure code. Visual intent lives here; pixel layout does not.

style.description: Open object declaring this deck's style/template intent (e.g. {template: ..., palette_hint: ...}). Code passes it through without interpreting; the tier-1 renderer ignores it, richer renderers consume it.

beat.description: Story beat ID (Sxx). Optional for covers; multi-beat merges need merge_rationale.

page_role.description: Known roles with validator rules: cover, agenda, section_divider, content, closing, appendix. Unknown roles are treated as content.

title.description: Message-style title: what the audience should remember from this page.

intent.description: Free-form visual intent; the renderer decides how to realize it.

chart.description: Native chart drawn from the evidence store at render time. Values are pulled by value_from reference, so chart numbers cannot drift from evidence.

type.description: bar | column | line (renderer warns on unknown)

label.description: Category label; defaults to the evidence ID.

value_from.description: Evidence ID whose value.number is plotted.

asset_refs.description: Image assets for this page. Plain path strings (relative to run root) or objects {ref, caption, evidence} — caption renders with the image, evidence links the figure into the ID chain. Figures must not be a traceability blind spot.

notes.description: Speaker notes. First-class content, not an afterthought.

demotions.description: Audit of content cut from this page and where it went.

emphasis.description: Semantic emphasis (future animation vocabulary; renderers may ignore).

reveal.description: Semantic reveal order (future animation vocabulary; renderers may ignore).

merge_rationale.description: Required when one page merges multiple beats.
